## Goal
Combine WO-291 and WO-292 into `recheck_suggestion(broker, gaps) -> RecheckSuggestion` (a small frozen dataclass: `interval_days`, `reason` code, `text`). Reason codes: `default` (no history), `relists_often` (interval shortened), `rarely_relists` (kept at the broker's own interval), `capped` (clamped). The `text` is one plain sentence for older readers ("This site put your listing back after 12 days before, so we will look again in 7 days."), with no names. Pure; not wired into any output.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Each reason code is produced by at least one table row; `interval_days` always equals `learned_interval_days` for the same inputs.
2. `text` is under 25 words, has no "guarantee", "erase", "100%" or "safe", and says "look again" in days; the singular is right for 1 day.
3. The broker name is never put in `text`; only `broker.recheck_interval_days` and the gaps are read.
4. A broker with `recheck_interval_days=1` and many fast relists returns the floor and reason `capped`, not 0.
5. Existing monitor tests and WO-291/292 tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
